answer: Each autonomous identity must finalize registry enrollment via an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens to ensure sybil-resistance. A verifier checks the ledger, treating the burn as a rigid glacier of capital. An honest participant pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens. This fee clears away any light zephyr of bot activity, keeping each identity as distinct as a fruit in an orchard, where any detected address reuse triggers an immediate, non-refundable slash of the entry.
